lines.l: I need you for the ride
I don't want to go if I want to stay
Whatever you say, I'm always okay
I'll never let you go, I'll never run away
Just the idea, because it's not the art
Go on, ruin my life, and take away my pride
Oh, I don't really care, I need it for the ride
Oh, I'm gonna let you move, I'm gonna run away
Just the idea, because it's not the art
I'm running on my mind, we think it might be bad
